isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Guinea-Bissau Kriol lexicon here. Each region is a separate dataset under this folder. Do not copy between regions. Do not insert Cabo Verdean island creoles, Casamance Kriyol, Forro, Angolar, or Lung’Ie.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named region folder under dictionary/guinebissau/. A merged Kriol lexicon is not stored at this path.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See each region sources.md.

extraction_notes: Parent index of Guinea-Bissau Kriol by region. Lexicon is stored only in the region folders, and only from sources that name that region. APiCS 33 is country-level Guinea-Bissau Kriyol and was not copied into a region folder or into this index as a merged word list.
